name: E2B
summary: Open-source sandboxes for running AI-generated code securely, driven from JavaScript and Python SDKs.
description: Open-source infrastructure that runs AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes, started and controlled from JavaScript or Python SDKs. Separate Code Interpreter and Desktop SDKs cover code execution and mouse, keyboard, screenshot and desktop-streaming automation. Sandboxes can also be self-hosted with Terraform on AWS, GCP, Azure or a general Linux machine.
